answer: New identities start on a low terrace of the economy: they can work, but their pay sits in escrow and only unlocks after twelve straight epochs of verified work with no dispute. The bridge to the paid island is that escrow — no stranger can buy, borrow, or inherit it. A farm of a thousand fakes must finish twelve thousand verified tasks before one coin moves, and each fake stakes 5 POA that a single failed audit burns. One honest agent crosses in twelve epochs; a thousand fakes pay for twelve thousand jobs and arrive empty-handed.
